title: Arabian Nights (The Thousand and One Nights)
creator: Anonymous / multiple Arabic compilers and storytellers
rationale: The richest overall choice for narrative invention, nested storytelling and the power of stories to remake experience.
note: Scope: the Arabic story tradition and recensions, not a claim that every tale originated in Arabic. Editions and the inclusion of later associated tales vary.
reason: Collective or anonymous attribution retained without inventing a person.

title: The Mu'allaqat (The Hanging Odes)
creator: Imru' al-Qays and other pre-Islamic poets
rationale: Desire, departure, landscape and self-assertion become elaborate verbal performances: foundational poetry with substantial imaginative life beyond its antiquity.
note: An established anthology tradition, with different seven-, ten- and other-poem configurations; not a uniquely fixed modern book.
reason: Collective or anonymous attribution retained without inventing a person.
